## 2. Professional Biography
Muhammad Shoaib is a results-oriented Full-Stack Software Engineer with professional expertise in modern web ecosystems. With deep specializations in Next.js (App Router, Server Components, Server Actions), React, TypeScript, and Node.js, Shoaib builds lightning-fast, accessible, and scalable applications. His work bridges high-aesthetic interactive user interfaces with reliable, secure backend services and API integrations.
